run_paraphrase_search: run the LASER paraphrase tool to find similar sentences in a FAISS index from an input text file
run_margin_absolute: run the paraphrase search with absolute margin mode to find matches below a FAISS distance threshold
run_margin_ratio: run the paraphrase search with ratio margin mode to find matches based on distance-to-average ratio
calculate_l2_distance: calculate true L2 distance between query embeddings and indexed sentence embeddings stored on disk
buffered_read_sentences: read sentences from a file in buffered batches for batched embedding and search processing
